label: Apple iPhone 16e smartphone
description: A18 phone with Apple's own C1 cellular modem: 5G NR sub-6 GHz only with 4x4 MIMO - n1/n2/n3/n5/n7/n8/n12/n14/n20/n25/n26/n28/n29/n30/n38/n40/n41/n48/n53/n66/n70/n71/n75/n76/n77/n78/n79, and no mmWave bands at all. Wi-Fi is 6 (802.11ax) with 2x2 MIMO - not 6E and not 7. Radios: one wlan (Wi-Fi 6) and one wwan (5G sub-6); the only port is USB-C, so no RJ45.
notes: Deliberate contrast node: Apple's first in-house modem, sub-6 only, and the Wi-Fi radio tops out at 802.11ax 2x2 - do not 'upgrade' this to Wi-Fi 6E/7 to match the rest of the Apple line. No Thread radio. wlan0 is modelled at 1G because 802.11ax 2x2 on 80 MHz channels peaks near 1.2 Gbps; quoting 2.5G here would be a Wi-Fi 6E/7 number this radio cannot reach. No Ethernet, USB-C only.
